name: DaYan GuHong Pro M 3x3 54mm (MagLev)
description: The DaYan GuHong Pro M 3x3 is the latest release from the famous speedcubing brand. This 3x3 is magnetic, has a glossy outer finish, and turns well right out of the box. Choose between 5 different tension settings that you can adjust by hand! Give this brand a fresh look with the GuHong Pro M. This is the 54mm MagLev version. It replaces the springs with opposing magnets.
